infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SecureOps uses your location to verify you are on-site when you clock in and to share your live position with dispatch while you are on shift.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SecureOps uses your location in the background while you are clocked in so dispatch can be alerted if you leave your assigned site or trigger an emergency.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SecureOps to use your camera so you can snap a fresh photo of your TX security license, passport, or training certificates from the field.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow SecureOps to access your photo library so you can attach an existing image of your TX security license, passport, or training certificates.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SecureOps uses your location in the background while you are clocked in so dispatch can be alerted if you leave your assigned site or trigger an emergency.
